summary: Round 72 CRM frontend testing — all critical flows PASS. Tested import dialog (CSV upload, dedupe 1/1, template button, result panel), CRM search/filter source, pipeline card→detail navigation (eye button), tabella row→detail (tel:/mailto: clickable, 35 tel + 25 mailto links), LeadDetail full coverage: 4 quick actions (tel:, wa.me/, mailto:, google maps) with correct hrefs, edit→save toggle (INPUT→DIV), state change (5 stati buttons), note types (4) with conditional esito select (chiamata shows, nota hides), note add+timeline, source label visible in detail. 42 → 43 leads after import confirms dedupe works.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid prop not forwarded to rendered element — lead-badge-stato testid not findable in DOM though badge renders visually. Likely Badge component does not spread extra props. Affects automation/testing only.

action_items: (Optional/low) Make ui-kit Badge component forward {...rest} so data-testid attribute reaches DOM — enables automated assertion of stato badge text.
critical_code_review_comments: LeadDetail.jsx ~280 LOC, well structured, clear separation between edit/readonly. PUT /api/leads/:id used both for full update and partial stato change — server must accept partial body (worked in test).
ImportLeadsDialog uses fetch with credentials:include, bypassing axios — duplicated auth pattern. Consider unifying via api.post with multipart support to use same interceptors.
delNota does not catch error nor show toast on failure — minor UX gap.
Confirm dialogs use window.confirm — works but inconsistent with shadcn AlertDialog pattern used elsewhere; acceptable for MVP.
